mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_favorite (user_id, product_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, p.category_id, p.category, p.price AS price, p.original_price AS original_price, p.price AS base_price, p.stock, p.description, p.image_url, p.images, p.specs, p.status, p.merchant_id, p.sales_count, p.view_count, NULL AS promo_price, NULL AS promo_start_time, NULL AS promo_end_time, NULL AS promo_status, 0 AS promo_active, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM user_favorite uf JOIN product p ON uf.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC
